name: costas_array_n10__v0_nh
prompt:
Find a Costas array of order 10: place 10 marks on an 10x10 grid, one per row and one per column, such that all 10*(9)/2 displacement vectors (dr, dc) between pairs of marks (with dc > 0) are pairwise distinct.

Return x as a list of 10 integers in 0..9, where x[c] is the row of the mark in column c (permutation), or state "UNSATISFIABLE" if no such array exists.
